description_en: After enabling public network access for a Bastionhost instance, you can add IP addresses to a whitelist to control access
description_zh: 堡垒机实例开启公网访问后，可以将指定公网IP地址加入白名单，允许公网流量访问堡垒机实例
kebab_example: aliyun yundun-bastionhost config-instance-white-list --instance-id bastionhost-cn-78v1gh0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --region cn-hangzhou
name: ConfigInstanceWhiteList

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the Bastionhost instance to configure.

To obtain the instance ID, call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html operation
parameters.help_zh:
要配置公网IP地址白名单的堡垒机的实例ID。
可通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/153281.html接口获取堡垒机实例ID
parameters.name: instance_id

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the Bastionhost instance
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The list of IP addresses to add to the whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 需要配置的IP地址白名单
parameters.name: white_list

fields.help_en: The description of this whitelist rule
fields.help_zh: 对该条白名单规则的备注或描述
fields.name: description

fields.help_en: The IP addresses to add to the whitelist. You can specify up to 50 IP addresses, separated by a comma
fields.help_zh: 需要配置的 IP 地址白名单。最多支持配置 50 个 IP 地址。如果要将多个 IP 地址加入白名单，多个 IP 之间使用半角逗号（,）隔开
fields.name: entry

parameters.help_en: The policies for the public IP address whitelist
parameters.help_zh: 需要配置的 IP 地址白名单
parameters.name: white_list_policies

InstanceId.description_en: The ID of the Bastionhost instance whose whitelist was configured
InstanceId.description_zh: 已配置公网IP地址白名单的堡垒机实例ID

RequestId.description_en: A unique request ID generated by Alibaba Cloud. Use this ID to troubleshoot issues
RequestId.description_zh: 本次调用请求的ID，是由阿里云为该请求生成的唯一标识符，可用于排查和定位问题
